Accepted.description: What accepting an invitation answers: the workspace joined, at its role (INVITATIONS-005).

features.description:
One member per feature a deployment can turn off, `true` while the feature is on. A
feature this API doesn't have is absent.

CloseReason.description: Why the hub closed a stream, which `stream.closed` names (REALTIME-005).

Created.description: A workspace just created, with its creator's role (WORKSPACES-001).

Features.description: Each feature a deployment can turn off, and whether it is on.

email.description:
Whether the deployment sends email (PLATFORM-022). While it is off, a client hides what
needs email, such as a way to reset a password.

FieldError.description: One field of a request that failed validation (API-07, API-10).

code.description: Why the field failed, as a stable `snake_case` code, such as `too_long`.

field.description: The JSON Pointer of the field, such as `/email`.

message.description: The reason, for humans. Clients act on `code`, never on this (ERR-09).

Frame.description: A frame of the stream of server-sent events, one schema for each type, which its `event` names (REALTIME-008).

Invitation.description:
An invitation to a workspace (INVITATIONS-001). `Deserialize` only reads back a stored result
that an idempotency key replays (PLATFORM-036).

inviter_id.description: The member who invited, or refreshed the invitation last.

workspace_id.description: The workspace it offers to join.

InvitationReceived.description: The payload of `invitation.received`: an invitation for the user's address.

invitation_id.description: The invitation, which the user may accept.

workspace_id.description: The workspace it invites them to.

InvitationReceivedFrame.description: `invitation.received`, a user event: it reaches its user's streams.

trace_id.description: The trace ID of the request or job that published the event, or of the request that opened the stream, for a frame of the stream's own; null for an event published outside a trace (REALTIME-002).

data.description: JSON: the payload, and the trace ID of what sent it (REALTIME-002).

id.description: What a client that reconnects names in `Last-Event-ID` (REALTIME-004).

role.description: The role to offer, which must rank below the inviter's (ACCESS-004).

List_Member.description: A page of items, and the cursor of the next page, or `null` on the last (API-05).

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page, which `cursor` takes, or `null` on the last page.

List_ReceivedInvitation.description: A page of items, and the cursor of the next page, or `null` on the last (API-05).

items.description: One of the caller's own invitations (INVITATIONS-004).

inviter_name.description: The name of the member who invited.

workspace_id.description: The workspace it offers to join.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page, which `cursor` takes, or `null` on the last page.

List_WorkspaceItem.description: A page of items, and the cursor of the next page, or `null` on the last (API-05).

items.description: A workspace the caller belongs to (WORKSPACES-003).

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page, which `cursor` takes, or `null` on the last page.

MemberJoined.description: The payload of `member.joined`: someone joined the workspace by accepting an invitation.

MemberJoinedFrame.description: `member.joined`, a workspace event: it reaches the streams of the workspace's members who hold `members.read` (SEC-19).

trace_id.description: The trace ID of the request or job that published the event, or of the request that opened the stream, for a frame of the stream's own; null for an event published outside a trace (REALTIME-002).

data.description: JSON: the payload, and the trace ID of what sent it (REALTIME-002).

id.description: What a client that reconnects names in `Last-Event-ID` (REALTIME-004).

MemberRemoved.description: The payload of `member.removed`: a member was removed from the workspace.

MemberRemovedFrame.description: `member.removed`, a workspace event: it reaches the streams of the workspace's members who hold `members.read` (SEC-19).

trace_id.description: The trace ID of the request or job that published the event, or of the request that opened the stream, for a frame of the stream's own; null for an event published outside a trace (REALTIME-002).

data.description: JSON: the payload, and the trace ID of what sent it (REALTIME-002).

id.description: What a client that reconnects names in `Last-Event-ID` (REALTIME-004).

MembershipCreated.description: The payload of `membership.created`: the user joined a workspace.

session_id.description: The session whose request added them, so that device can tell it already knows.

MembershipCreatedFrame.description: `membership.created`, a user event: it reaches its user's streams.

trace_id.description: The trace ID of the request or job that published the event, or of the request that opened the stream, for a frame of the stream's own; null for an event published outside a trace (REALTIME-002).

data.description: JSON: the payload, and the trace ID of what sent it (REALTIME-002).

id.description: What a client that reconnects names in `Last-Event-ID` (REALTIME-004).

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem, with the error's stable code and the request's trace ID.

detail.description: A sentence about this occurrence, for humans. Clients act on `code`, never on this.

errors.description: The fields that failed validation, present only for a validation failure.

title.description: A short summary, the same for every occurrence of the code.

trace_id.description: The trace ID of the request.

email_verified.description: Whether the user proved they receive email at the address.

ReceivedInvitation.description: One of the caller's own invitations (INVITATIONS-004).

inviter_name.description: The name of the member who invited.

workspace_id.description: The workspace it offers to join.

RefreshRequest.description: What refreshing takes: the refresh token, unless a browser's cookie holds it (AUTH-010).

refresh_token.description: The session's current refresh token. A browser leaves it out, and its cookie carries it.

oneOf.description: An ID the client keeps for its installation (AUTH-008, AUTH-017).

Role.description: A member's role, from the highest rank to the lowest (ACCESS-001, SEC-09).

Session.description: A session, as its client sees it.

oneOf.description: The device ID the client signed in with, if any.

expires_at.description: When the session ends, whatever its refreshes.

refresh_token_expires_at.description: When its refresh token expires, unless a refresh slides it.

user_id.description: The user the session signs in.

SessionResponse.description: A session, and its tokens when they go in the body.

access_token.description: The access token, unless the tokens went in cookies.

oneOf.description: The device ID the client signed in with, if any.

device_token.description:
The device token of a registration or a sign-in, unless the tokens went in cookies, which
the client sends with its next sign-in (AUTH-019).

expires_at.description: When the session ends, whatever its refreshes.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token, unless the tokens went in cookies.

refresh_token_expires_at.description: When its refresh token expires, unless a refresh slides it.

user_id.description: The user the session signs in.

oneOf.description: An ID the client keeps for its installation (AUTH-008, AUTH-017).

device_token.description:
The device token that the account's last registration or sign-in on this device returned
(AUTH-019). A browser leaves it out, and its cookie carries it. One that isn't valid for
the email counts as none.

StreamClosedFrame.description: `stream.closed`, the stream's last frame, which says why it closed; the client reconnects (REALTIME-005).

trace_id.description: The trace ID of the request or job that published the event, or of the request that opened the stream, for a frame of the stream's own; null for an event published outside a trace (REALTIME-002).

data.description: JSON: the payload, and the trace ID of what sent it (REALTIME-002).

truncated.description: Whether the replay was truncated, so the client reloads its state (REALTIME-004).

StreamOpenedFrame.description: `stream.opened`, the stream's first frame. Its `id`, when it has one, is where a reconnect resumes a stream that started with what commits next (REALTIME-001, REALTIME-004).

trace_id.description: The trace ID of the request or job that published the event, or of the request that opened the stream, for a frame of the stream's own; null for an event published outside a trace (REALTIME-002).

data.description: JSON: the payload, and the trace ID of what sent it (REALTIME-002).

id.description: What a client that reconnects names in `Last-Event-ID` (REALTIME-004).

WorkspaceItem.description: A workspace the caller belongs to (WORKSPACES-003).
